2) Options we can do now (pick one):

   - Option B: Move to 2026-03-26 08:00 UTC — APAC morning, EU early afternoon, US late night (less ideal).
   - Option C: Keep the current slot but we record and provide a 25-minute async recording + a 30-minute regional Q&A the next day for US/APAC separately.

3) Staffing: Karthik is on a flight during the original slot; Mina can run the demo if we pick Option A or C. If you want Karthik specifically, Option B would give him time on-ground (but he's still transitioning timezones).

I've attached an updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a short recording consent stub (recording-consent.txt) you can use. I'll also send an .ics with both Option A/B candidate times so you can put them into your calendar.

Can you confirm which of the three you prefer and whether you need Karthik in the session or if Mina is OK to lead? If you pick Option A we can email the updated invite with UTC labeled times to minimize confusion.

Best,
